This item represents the change in the non-credit impairment losses portion of other-than-temporary impairments on fixed maturity investments in which a credit loss was recognized in the Consolidated Statements of Income. This item includes the impact of subsequent changes to these securities such as appreciation or loss in value or subsequent sale of the security.
